# Decision Index

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by `pnpm gen:adr-index` from memory-bank/standards/decisions/*.md. DO NOT EDIT this file by hand. -->

The decisions behind RelaxJer, one file each under [`decisions/`](./decisions/), grouped by domain. Read the Rule
column first: it is the decision in one line. Open the ADR for its reasons (Context, Alternatives, Consequences).
To add a decision, follow [`../../.claude/rules/memory-bank.md`](../../.claude/rules/memory-bank.md), then run
`pnpm gen:adr-index`.

**Ids** are `ADR-YYYYMMDD-slug`, never a shared counter, so parallel branches and pull requests never collide. A
merged id never changes; a new ADR that collides takes a fresh slug.

## engine

How a trip becomes the page: the views, the sections, the day logic and the packs. Patterns: [engine.md](./patterns/engine.md).

| ADR                                                                                     | Date       | Status   | Rule                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [ADR-20261007-split-follows-pushback](decisions/ADR-20261007-split-follows-pushback.md) | 2026-10-07 | accepted | A split fork moves like a flexible stop: push-backs before it shift it, and its rejoin keeps its stop planned time.                                  |
| [ADR-20261117-native-layer](decisions/ADR-20261117-native-layer.md)                     | 2026-11-17 | accepted | A pack sets the native language and the 'please take us here' card text, and the engine reads them from the pack, never a constant.                  |
| [ADR-20261122-currency-switch](decisions/ADR-20261122-currency-switch.md)               | 2026-11-22 | accepted | Currency conversion happens while the text is drawn, in one pure function that reads each amount's own symbol, so NT$ is never read as $.            |
| [ADR-20261122-day-views](decisions/ADR-20261122-day-views.md)                           | 2026-11-22 | amended  | Each tab is its own view with its own #address and Back step; a day's planning cards open as sheets from one-line summaries; TRIP.sky picks the sky. |
| [ADR-20261122-place-finder-best-day](decisions/ADR-20261122-place-finder-best-day.md)   | 2026-11-22 | amended  | A place finder ranks each day's stops by straight-line distance to the place, counting only stops a new stop can follow.                             |
| [ADR-20261124-finder-google-distance](decisions/ADR-20261124-finder-google-distance.md) | 2026-11-24 | accepted | With a key, the finder asks Google once per place for the way from the group: metres by road and the walk at the group pace, or the ride.            |
| [ADR-20261127-trip-walk-pace](decisions/ADR-20261127-trip-walk-pace.md)                 | 2026-11-27 | accepted | TRIP.walkPace (a number from 1 to 2) scales every walking time the page shows; left out, the seniors' pace; 1 is Google's own time.                  |
| [ADR-20261128-skip-planned-stops](decisions/ADR-20261128-skip-planned-stops.md)         | 2026-11-28 | accepted | Anyone may skip a planned stop but a flight or the lodging; it folds away, syncs with who, undoes, and only suggests moving later stops earlier.     |

## trip-data

A trip's data and the pipeline that refreshes it: the fields, the contract and the cost of a refresh. Patterns: [trip-data.md](./patterns/trip-data.md), [pipeline.md](./patterns/pipeline.md).

| ADR                                                                                   | Date       | Status   | Rule                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [ADR-20260930-google-keys](decisions/ADR-20260930-google-keys.md)                     | 2026-09-30 | accepted | RelaxJer ships no Google keys: each user creates their own, a referrer-restricted browser key and a separate server key, never mixed.                  |
| [ADR-20261001-day-split](decisions/ADR-20261001-day-split.md)                         | 2026-10-01 | amended  | A day can split for part of the group: DAYS[i].split names where it forks and who goes, and the trip contract checks it.                               |
| [ADR-20261001-option-chips](decisions/ADR-20261001-option-chips.md)                   | 2026-10-01 | accepted | An optional plan attaches to a stop with OPTIONAL[i].near, shown as a dashed chip on that stop, and the contract checks the stop exists.               |
| [ADR-20261001-resync-cost-guard](decisions/ADR-20261001-resync-cost-guard.md)         | 2026-10-01 | amended  | A data refresh answers from the cache first and calls Google again only for failures that may pass on retry, never for a 404.                          |
| [ADR-20261007-traffic-aware-drives](decisions/ADR-20261007-traffic-aware-drives.md)   | 2026-10-07 | amended  | A drive leg may carry an HH:MM time, and a drive still ahead uses Google's traffic-aware estimate for that time.                                       |
| [ADR-20261126-own-leg-minutes](decisions/ADR-20261126-own-leg-minutes.md)             | 2026-11-26 | accepted | A route leg may end with the trip's own minutes, shown only when Google has no time for it; Japan's transit is never asked.                            |
| [ADR-20261127-decide-option-route](decisions/ADR-20261127-decide-option-route.md)     | 2026-11-27 | accepted | A decide option may carry its own route; its legs are stored as <day>:<k>:<i> in geo.json, apart from the day's, and drawn on its card.                |
| [ADR-20261128-budget-paid-insurance](decisions/ADR-20261128-budget-paid-insurance.md) | 2026-11-28 | amended  | Budget rows can be paid (date, where, ref), in the home currency, in parts, or price TBD; the glance is the paid total. INSURANCE: a tile, no IDs.     |
| [ADR-20261128-drive-stops](decisions/ADR-20261128-drive-stops.md)                     | 2026-11-28 | accepted | drive-stops.json: rest stops along each 90+ min drive from Places search along the route; folded under its row, never planned; Next by the clock.      |
| [ADR-20261128-tax-refund](decisions/ADR-20261128-tax-refund.md)                       | 2026-11-28 | amended  | TAX gains steps, methods, airport (rows, wifi), deadline, coupons (until, img), src; a tile in Today opens them; coupon images go in at full size.     |
| [ADR-20261128-water-refill](decisions/ADR-20261128-water-refill.md)                   | 2026-11-28 | accepted | refill.json: OSM drinking water plus trip-local refill-*.json, merged by a free step; a pill per stop, a map kind, near me; winter hides outdoor taps. |

## sync

Group sync: the shared database, who may change what, and the roles of each phone. No pattern file: the rules live in these ADRs.

| ADR                                                                   | Date       | Status   | Rule                                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [ADR-20261001-group-sync](decisions/ADR-20261001-group-sync.md)       | 2026-10-01 | amended  | Group sync runs on each planner's own Firebase Realtime Database, one per planner, in the trip's region, with no shared server of ours.      |
| [ADR-20261002-sync-planners](decisions/ADR-20261002-sync-planners.md) | 2026-10-02 | amended  | A role belongs to a phone, not a name: planner changes are per device, and the undo toast and busy-day caution ship on every page.           |
| [ADR-20261127-sync-approval](decisions/ADR-20261127-sync-approval.md) | 2026-11-27 | accepted | The page stays on ht-ml.app; a device reads or writes group sync only after a planner approves it, enforced by anonymous Auth and the rules. |
| [ADR-20261127-while-away](decisions/ADR-20261127-while-away.md)       | 2026-11-27 | accepted | Changes read on opening the page or coming back to it go into a card on Today, kept on the phone until Got it; no push and no new service.   |

| [ADR-20261001-page-csp](decisions/ADR-20261001-page-csp.md)                                       | 2026-10-01 | accepted | The build writes a strict Content-Security-Policy into each page: hashed inline scripts, no unsafe-inline, and connect-src limited to known hosts. |

## design

How the page looks, moves and reads: type, colour, illustrations, motion, names and controls. Patterns: [frontend.md](./patterns/frontend.md), [affordances.md](./patterns/affordances.md).

| ADR                                                                                     | Date       | Status   | Rule                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [ADR-20260930-name-relaxjer](decisions/ADR-20260930-name-relaxjer.md)                   | 2026-09-30 | accepted | The product is called RelaxJer: the exact name is unclaimed, so the site can rank for it, and it carries the lowest legal risk.                                 |
| [ADR-20261002-embed-brush-font](decisions/ADR-20261002-embed-brush-font.md)             | 2026-10-02 | accepted | The build embeds the brush font's glyphs the page uses as base64 woff2, so the page renders the same offline.                                                   |
| [ADR-20261002-landing-postcards](decisions/ADR-20261002-landing-postcards.md)           | 2026-10-02 | accepted | Each landing-page feature is a postcard: a drawn mini trip page on one spot colour, with its stamp and copy on the back.                                        |
| [ADR-20261117-destination-themes](decisions/ADR-20261117-destination-themes.md)         | 2026-11-17 | amended  | A pack may name one visual world; a city's world overrides its country's, and each world is two files in engine/src/themes/.                                    |
| [ADR-20261121-world-motion](decisions/ADR-20261121-world-motion.md)                     | 2026-11-21 | amended  | A moving part of a picture is a top-level group with data-actor, and splitArt returns the still drawing plus each moving part as its own SVG.                   |
| [ADR-20261121-world-stickers](decisions/ADR-20261121-world-stickers.md)                 | 2026-11-21 | accepted | Day colours keep text contrast at 4.5:1 or more on light paper and 3.8:1 or more on dark; tints are fixed shares of the colour.                                 |
| [ADR-20261124-bottom-app-bar](decisions/ADR-20261124-bottom-app-bar.md)                 | 2026-11-24 | amended  | Below 1024 px a bottom bar (Today, Days, Map, More) replaces the date strip and the Sections button, and the sky’s Pause moves into More.                       |
| [ADR-20261124-grouped-lists](decisions/ADR-20261124-grouped-lists.md)                   | 2026-11-24 | amended  | The rail, Days, More and the Sections sheet are grouped lists: cards of 52 px rows split by inset hairlines, each row ending in ›, a value with ⌃⌄, or nothing. |
| [ADR-20261124-map-first-search](decisions/ADR-20261124-map-first-search.md)             | 2026-11-24 | amended  | Search results and the finder lie over the map (sheet or side panel); a picked place is framed with the group and marked, no line; filters behind one button.   |
| [ADR-20261128-progressive-disclosure](decisions/ADR-20261128-progressive-disclosure.md) | 2026-11-28 | amended  | Glance layer open (Now/Next, hotel, week, day card, one-line stops); lists fold with a count; single parts are icon tiles; one money number.                    |

## tooling

The repo layout, the toolchain, CI and releases, dependency rules, and the agent setup and docs. No pattern file: the rules live in these ADRs.

| ADR                                                                                               | Date       | Status   | Rule                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [ADR-20260930-repo-layout](decisions/ADR-20260930-repo-layout.md)                                 | 2026-09-30 | accepted | One repo: engine/ builds the page, pipeline/ refreshes the data, destinations/ holds country and city packs, trips/ is git-ignored.          |
| [ADR-20261001-memory-bank-agent-config](decisions/ADR-20261001-memory-bank-agent-config.md)       | 2026-10-01 | accepted | Project context lives in memory-bank/ and agent tooling works for any agent; Claude Code extras stay in .claude/ on top.                     |
| [ADR-20261001-project-tooling](decisions/ADR-20261001-project-tooling.md)                         | 2026-10-01 | amended  | pnpm is pinned by Corepack, a release must be 3 days old before it installs, and install scripts stay off unless listed.                     |
| [ADR-20261002-ci-image-and-releases](decisions/ADR-20261002-ci-image-and-releases.md)             | 2026-10-02 | amended  | E2e runs on arm64 runners in a Playwright image whose version matches package.json, and a release is tagged and published after CI is green. |
| [ADR-20261002-feature-docs-planner-skills](decisions/ADR-20261002-feature-docs-planner-skills.md) | 2026-10-02 | accepted | One planner catalogue, guides/trip-page.md, explains every part of the page; trip-format.md stays the field reference.                       |
| [ADR-20261007-squash-merges](decisions/ADR-20261007-squash-merges.md)                             | 2026-10-07 | accepted | Squash and merge is the only merge method: the PR title becomes the commit title, unless the branch has a single commit.                     |
| [ADR-20261008-release-age-exceptions](decisions/ADR-20261008-release-age-exceptions.md)           | 2026-10-08 | accepted | The 3-day release-age gate stays; an early install is allowed only for exact name@version entries, one per package a release needs.          |
| [ADR-20261122-adr-index-by-domain](decisions/ADR-20261122-adr-index-by-domain.md)                 | 2026-11-22 | accepted | ADR files stay flat and date-based; each ADR has one domain from a closed list and a one-line decision, and the index groups by domain.      |

## testing

The test tiers, the checks that gate a merge, and the rules for e2e tests. Patterns: [testing.md](./patterns/testing.md).

| ADR                                                                   | Date       | Status   | Rule                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [ADR-20260930-test-strategy](decisions/ADR-20260930-test-strategy.md) | 2026-09-30 | accepted | Tests run in tiers: fast repo and unit tests always, a browser e2e pass on the built page, and real-trip checks only on a laptop. |
| [ADR-20261002-required-ci](decisions/ADR-20261002-required-ci.md)     | 2026-10-02 | accepted | One ci-ok job needs every other CI job and fails unless all pass, so a single required check guards every merge.                  |
